items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well I would call Snooky Young and tell him about the party so he could go too. [INTERVIEWEE] He definitely would be there.

ctx.x: But I’m sure I left out a lot of great trumpet players that I’d invite, but off the top of my head quick I can’t —
Well I would call Snooky Young and tell him about the party so he could go too.

He definitely would be there. That’s for sure. Yeah definitely. We have Tom Delibero, he’s a local trumpet player here, he’s a great player too. He definitely be sure — yeah there are so many good ones you know. Chase used to live here.
